caption: This drawing depicts a square patchwork quilt composed of a variety of irregularly shaped fabric fragments sewn together. The quilt is made up of a grid of sixteen smaller squares, each filled with its own assortment of fabric pieces in different shapes and sizes. The colors within the patchwork are varied, including red, blue, green, yellow, black, pink, purple, beige, and white, among other hues. Many of the fabric pieces display patterns such as stripes, dots, florals, and geometric shapes. Embroidery stitches in contrasting thread colors outline the edges of individual fabric pieces and create decorative borders between them. Some squares have monograms or initials stitched on them, and one square near the bottom center features a blue rectangular section containing a stylized drawing, possibly of birds. The patchwork square occupies the center of the page, with a wide margin of blank, cream-colored paper surrounding it. The overall composition is symmetrical, and the textures and colors of the fabrics are visually distinct from one another.
title: Crazy Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
